title: Provider execution security boundary

controls.credentials: secret-manager references only; values never enter the contract; injection is ephemeral and cleaned on completion or cancellation
controls.network: HTTPS port 443, TLS 1.3 peer verification, declared egress allowlist only
controls.transport: bounded request/response bytes, frame size/count, timeout, idle timeout, stream window, and cancellation grace
controls.evidence: redacted status/outcome and frame digests only; unknown provider outcomes remain unverified
controls.reliability: retries are correlated, duplicate requests are rejected, and partial failure is explicit

failure_semantics.side_effects: No provider, network, LLM, credential manager, process, Coordinator, or durable-state operation is performed.

limitations: The checker validates synthetic observations and does not prove secret-manager behavior, TLS enforcement, host isolation, provider availability, or live cancellation.
Offline qualification is not provider success, remote verification, or production security qualification.
